notes: SOURCE: east-facing beach, mountains on all other sides, no plants/animals/structures, irregular flood and ebb tides, iron gate engraved EXIST as the entrance, entrance on the west mountain (audio log), clean beach without tools, pebbles, north end is a cliff of nothing but sand, wave sound that turns into machines/tracks/jets/talking/crying/praying near the water, clear water with rust, building debris and daily necessities, safe distances 15/30/40 m, sudden fog then the tide, 'go back to where you came from'. ADAPTATION: bay scaled to ~0.6 x 0.2 km (page: up to ~20 km2 at ebb), closed by a mountain ring and headlands with the open sea to the east (sea plane to the horizon, haze); a gorge with a 13 % slope climbs to the gate ledge (~7.6 m, second walkable height); the gate's stone piers, M.E.G. notice wired to it and the creak that guides you in fog are ours; tide = noise-driven sea level between -0.6 and +0.55 m, one flood event triggered by standing within 3 m of the water (as in the audio log) or after an irregular 6-12 min, 32 s haze then a flood that accelerates to ~0.19 m/s up to +11 m; drowning when water is 1.15 m above the feet during the flood; the pebble interaction mirrors the log's missing splash; terrain uses CC0 Poly Haven coast_sand_01 / aerial_rocks_02 textures through a level shader. QA fixture: the flood never starts in QA mode; the gate exit is ~8 m from start.
entity_policy: NO ENTITY PER SOURCE ('no entities exist in this level'). The faces in the sea are TESTIMONY from an audio log of unverifiable authenticity: they are never modelled, only heard (whispers under the surf) and described in a caption when the player stands within 3 m of the water.
